title: Getaway to South Korea & Japan | A Journey Through Vibrant Cultures
highlights: Embark on an unforgettable journey through Japan and South Korea, where timeless traditions intertwine with cutting-edge modernity.
Walk through the silent passage of the Third Tunnel, a hidden marvel beneath the DMZ, offering a powerful glimpse into the resilience and Korea’s divided history.
Step back in time at Sensoji, Tokyo’s oldest temple and marvel at its traditional Japanese architecture with intricate wooden carvings and stunning tiled roofs.
Feel like stepping into another world as you stroll through the stunning Arashiyama Bamboo Grove in Kyoto, offering a perfect escape into nature.
Pay tribute to the past at Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park, where the iconic Atomic Bomb Dome stands as a solemn reminder of 1945.

know_before_you_go: Any activities or transfers not specified in the itinerary are not part of the package and require separate arrangements.
All visitors are required to carry valid ID proof.
Please be aware that the package does not cover the cost of the visa, which must be obtained separately.
Travel insurance is not included in the package.
Kindly note that personal expenses are not included in the package and should be budgeted separately.
Alcoholic Drinks are not included in the package.
Both countries have efficient public transport.
Japan uses the Japanese Yen (JPY), and South Korea uses the Korean Won (KRW).
Respect local customs, such as bowing in Japan and removing shoes before entering traditional homes or temples in both countries.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Seoul | Day At Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Seoul! Upon your arrival at the airport, get transferred to your hotel. Post check-in, spend the day at your leisure, where you can head out and explore the stunning Bukchon Hanok Village. Also, you can visit Seoul Tower’s observatory and soak in the stunning views of the city. You can also immerse yourself in history at the National Museum of Korea and the grand Gyeongbokgung Palace. Later, you can stroll through Gangnam Street, renowned for its fine dining, and vibrant atmosphere.

days.title: Korea DMZ Tour
days.desc: Today, head to Seoul Station & board your transfer for a DMZ tour. Start with a visit to Imjingak Pyeonghoa-Nuri Park & walk across the Bridge of Freedom, a historical site where prisoners were released in 1953. Also, gain deeper insights into the Korean War at the DMZ Theater & explore the Third Tunnel, a key passage used during the war. Then, soak in the views of North Korea from the Dora Observatory & you can also visit the Gamaksan Chulleong Bridge before getting driven to the meeting point.

items.title: DMZ Tour From Seoul on a Shared basis

days.title: Fly to Osaka | Day at Leisure
days.desc: After check-out, get transferred to the airport for your flight to Osaka. Upon arrival, get driven to your hotel and check-in. Then, spend the rest of the day at leisure, where you can explore the vibrant Dotonbori district, famous for its neon lights and delicious street food. Also, you can visit the Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan, one of the world's largest aquariums and take in breathtaking 360-degree city views from the Umeda Sky Building’s Floating Garden Observatory. Later, return to your hotel.

days.title: Osaka Walking Tour
days.desc: Today, head to the Osaka Tourist Information Center for a guided walking tour of the city. Begin by exploring Shinsekai, one of Osaka’s iconic streets, and admire the traditional Japanese houses at Hozenji Yokocho. Next, soak in the lively atmosphere of the Dotonbori District, where you can try Osaka's famous street foods like takoyaki & okonomiyaki. Conclude your day at Ebisu Bridge, offering scenic views of the bustling Dotonbori area. Later, explore Osaka's other attractions at your own pace.

days.title: Day Trip to Kyoto and Nara
days.desc: In the morning, head to the Namba Ocat Building and board your transfer for a trip to Kyoto & Nara. During the trip, visit Kinkakuji Temple & witness its famous gold-leafed exterior reflecting in the pond. Continue to the Arashiyama District and stroll through towering bamboo groves, offering a magical experience. Then, visit Nara Park, where you can interact with friendly deer in one of Japan’s most iconic parks. Afterwards, get driven to the Namba Ocat Building and return to your hotel.

items.title: Full-Day Tour to Kyoto & Nara - Osaka Namba Dep/Buffet Lunch

days.title: Transfer to Hiroshima | Day at Leisure
days.desc: In the morning, head to the Osaka Station and catch a bullet train to Hiroshima Station. Upon arrival, head to your hotel on your own and check-in. Then, spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can explore the Hiroshima Botanical Garden, home to over 1,000 plant species, or visit the Hiroshima Museum of Art, showcasing a collection of European and Japanese masterpieces. Also, you can delve into Japan’s maritime history at the Yamato Museum. Later, return to your hotel on your own.

days.title: Hiroshima & Miyajima Island Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, head to the pickup point at Hotel Granvia for the Miyajima & Hiroshima tour. Start with a visit to Peace Memorial Park, a poignant symbol of global peace and visit the Atomic Bomb Dome, which offers a deep reflection on the history of the atomic bombing. Then, take a ferry to Miyajima Island and visit the iconic Itsukushima Shrine, renowned for its stunning floating torii gates. After an amazing day, get driven back to Hotel Granvia and then, return to your hotel on your own.

days.title: Transfer to Tokyo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: In the morning, after check-out, head to the Hiroshima Station and take a bullet train to Tokyo. Upon arrival, head to your hotel on your own. Post check-in, spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can enjoy a peaceful stroll through Suminda Park and Yoyogi Park, two of Tokyo’s largest green spaces. Also, you can soak in the vibrant atmosphere of the Ginza District, renowned for its fine dining and boutiques. Later, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, head to the LOVE Sculpture, the meeting point for your Tokyo city tour. Once there, board your bus & visit the stunning Meiji Jingu Shrine. Next, visit the Imperial Palace, home to Japan’s royal family, & continue to Senso-ji Temple, Tokyo's oldest temple, in the historic Asakusa district. Also, marvel at the stunning views from Tokyo Skytree’s observation deck & soak in the lively atmosphere of the Odaiba area. Later, get driven to LOVE Sculpture, & from there, return to your hotel.

items.title: Full Day Tokyo City Tour by Bus - From LOVE Statue with Lunch

days.title: Excursion to Mount Fuji-5th Station & Hakone
days.desc: In the morning, head to Shinjuku Love and board your transfer to the iconic Mt. Fuji. Upon reaching its 5th station, soak in the stunning views of the surrounding landscapes. Next, take the Hakone Ropeway, offering panoramic vistas of Lake Ashi and Mt. Fuji, as you make your way to the Owakudani Valley. Once there, marvel at its sulfur vents & hot springs. Afterward, get driven to Odawara Station & board the Shinkansen bullet train to Tokyo Station, from there, return to your hotel on your own.
